core_obligations: Reduce the etale-local properties to the schemes case by choosing surjective etale charts.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose charts and reduce the etale-local items.
Handle representability of both members of the pair.

difficulty_reason: For a morphism of thickenings of algebraic spaces over S with no cartesian hypothesis, nine properties are shown to be equivalent for the two members of the pair: affineness, surjectivity, quasi-compactness, universal closedness, integrality, separatedness, universal injectivity, universal openness and representability. The proof reduces the etale-local items to the schemes case by choosing charts, and handles representability and the remaining non-local items directly from the structure of thickenings. The chart reduction serving nine statements at once, plus the direct treatment of representability, is the content. Retained author proof at lines 2000-2016 statement, proof 2018-2041.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair decided from the statements alone. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes side treats a morphism of thickenings of schemes; this side treats algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: this side includes representability among the listed properties, which has no counterpart in the schemes list, so the lists and hence the propositions differ and both count.
